name: stugu-home
description: Ask ChatGPT about current and historical Home conditions through Stugu.

interface.shortDescription: Chat with your Home through Stugu.
interface.longDescription: A calm, read-only view of current readings, history, doors and windows, electricity, weather, alerts, and indoor-outdoor moisture response.
defaultPrompt: What is the temperature in Köket right now?
What was the average temperature in the Home last night?
How much electricity did we use yesterday?
Is the current wind consistent with the humidity change inside?
